name.value: Old Towne Inne Chuckwagon Bar & Grill

description.value: Old Towne Inne is a Wild West-themed licensed restaurant and inne in Boston Bar, at the heart of the Fraser Canyon, serving an expansive menu of pizzas, pastas, steaks, Fish & Chips, and over 21 burger varieties. It is the primary dining option in Boston Bar and draws strong reviews for its all-you-can-eat soup station and generous portions. The property also offers self-contained cabins and rooms, making it a potential overnight stop for cyclists tackling the Fraser Canyon corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is comprehensive and clearly confirms the business is an active licensed restaurant with accommodation on the Trans-Canada Highway in Boston Bar. Key amenity evidence comes from the /old-towne-inne/ subpage listing services: 'Free WiFi', 'Take-Out Orders', and 'Electric vehicle charging station' (for cars, not e-bikes specifically). Bike parking is not mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags. Phone and address match exactly between OSM and the website.
concerns: Website lists EV charging station under parking (likely a car-level charger); e-bike charging suitability unconfirmed.

Minor inconsistency on the website: front page says 'three self-contained cabins' plus 'a Jacuzzi suite', while the Cabins & Rooms page states 'four self-contained cabins' — not material to cycling directory but worth noting.
Bike parking not mentioned anywhere on site or in OSM tags; this is a gap for WWC accreditation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating licensed restaurant on the Trans-Canada Highway in Boston Bar — the only dining option in town — making it a high-value stop for cyclists traveling the Fraser Canyon. Strong website presence and multiple positive reviews confirm ongoing operations.
